text:
Maya (CS): Cygnus Analytics pilot starts tomorrow morning. They want regional routing pinned to sa-east and eu-west for latency + compliance. Can we provision peering and a temporary rate override for 72h? They're worried about renewal if demo has issues.
Ethan (AM): FYI they plan a demo ramp 09:00-11:00 BRT, expected burst ~3k req/min total. Asking for source IP exemptions: `198.51.100.0/24` and `203.0.113.0/28`. Also need headers preserved (x-customer-id).
Liam (SRE): We can do region pin + IP ACLs. Need exact QPS per region and sign-off from security for IP exceptions.
Maya (CS): Ask was +500 qps per region (so baseline ~100 qps). Requesting soft window to 600 qps on `/v1/generate` for sa-east and eu-west for 72h; auto-revoke after window. Customer mentions renewal contingent on p95 <50ms during demo.
Sofia (Eng-Infra): I'll prepare a policy bundle. Example snippet:
```
{
  \"route\": \"/v1/generate\",
  \"regions\": [\"sa-east-1\",\"eu-west-1\"],
  \"rate_policy\": {\"qps\":600, \"window_hours\":72, \"auto_revoke\":true},
  \"ip_exceptions\": [\"198.51.100.0/24\",\"203.0.113.0/28\"],
  \"preserve_headers\": [\"x-customer-id\"]
}
```
Sofia (Eng-Infra): I'll run `infractl apply --bundle cygnus-pilot-3312345678 --env staging` and smoke test, then promote to prod if green.
Ben (Platform): Deployed to staging, smoke tests ok (latency p95 42ms staging). Need one prod window at 08:30 UTC for rollout.
Maya (CS): Sending cURL test to customer to validate routing:
```
curl -H \"x-customer-id: cygnus-pilot\" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"ping\"}'
```
Liam (SRE): I've wired up alerting: `alert: cygnus-pilot-rate-window; threshold: error_rate>2% || p95>120ms`. Also created ticket INC-331234 for audit and rollback play.
ops-bot: Change queued -> INC-331234; staging->prod promote scheduled 08:30 UTC.
Ben (Platform): Promoted to prod at 08:33 UTC. Policy active in sa-east-1 and eu-west-1. Auto-revoke scheduled in 72h.
Maya (CS): Customer confirmed demo went well. They noted occasional header strip on retries — filed feedback with Eng.
Liam (SRE): Closing loop: renewal lead updated, CS flagged low risk now. Will monitor next 48h for regressions. :thumbsup:
